title.zh-TW: 兩顆石頭同時到：對稱的過度決定

subtitle.zh-TW: 兩顆石頭同時打中窗戶，任何一顆就夠把窗打破。
subtitle.en: Two rocks hit the window at once, and either one alone would break it.

story.zh-TW: 考慮丟石頭的情境。小蘇和小比各拿一塊石頭，在同一瞬間朝窗戶丟去。兩塊石頭同時打中窗戶，任一塊都足以打破窗戶。窗戶破了。兩人的處境完全對稱，沒有先後。
story.en: Suzy and Billy each pick up a rock and throw it at a window at the very same instant. The two rocks arrive together, and either one alone would be enough to break the window. The window breaks. The two throwers stand in exactly the same position; neither is first or second.

zh-TW.sentence: 小蘇和小比各拿一塊石頭，在同一瞬間朝窗戶丟去。

en.sentence: Suzy and Billy each pick up a rock and throw it at a window at the very same instant.

text.zh-TW: 小蘇的石頭確實打中了窗戶。另一顆石頭同時打中，小蘇的石頭照樣算數。
text.en: Her rock did hit the window; a second rock arriving at the same moment does not stop hers from counting.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型取自 Halpern (2016) 例 2.3.3 的粗略模型。ST 表示小蘇丟，BT 表示小比丟，兩者由模型之外給定。任一人丟，窗戶就破（BS = ST ∨ BT）。ST 和 BT 在方程式中地位相同，所以每個定義對兩人的判斷都一樣。兩個各自足夠的原因同時發生，這叫做過度決定（overdetermination）。Chockler 與 Halpern (2004) 給每人的責任度是 1/2。
explanation.en: The model is the coarse model MRT of Halpern (2016, Ex. 2.3.3): each thrower's act is set by an exogenous variable, and the window breaks if either throws (BS = ST ∨ BT). The two variables play identical roles in the equations, so every theory treats the two throwers alike. It differs from the rock-throwing (late preemption) case only in lacking the intermediate variables SH and BH: the rocks arrive together, so neither blocks the other. The plain but-for test says neither throw is a cause. The original and updated HP definitions each hold the other thrower at "did not throw" and call both throws causes. The modified HP definition makes the two throws together one cause, and each alone only part of a cause. Chockler and Halpern (2004, Ex. 3.4) give Suzy's throw a degree of responsibility of 1/2 in this coarse model; the throwers are symmetric, so the same holds for Billy.

sources.citation: Halpern, J. Y. (2016). Actual Causality. MIT Press.
sources.pages: p. 30 (Example 2.3.3, the coarse model M_RT: BS = BT ∨ ST)

note.zh-TW: Halpern (2016) 例 2.3.3 先給出粗略模型 BS = BT ∨ ST，ST 與 BT 角色對稱。原始版與更新版 HP 定義（Halpern–Pearl definition）判兩者都是原因，修正版判兩者的連言（conjunction）是原因。
note.en: Halpern (2016, Ex. 2.3.3) first gives the coarse model BS = BT ∨ ST, notes that ST and BT play symmetric roles, and states that the original and updated HP definitions classify both as causes while the modified definition classifies their conjunction as the cause.

sources.citation: Hall, N. (2004). Two concepts of causation. In J. Collins, N. Hall, & L. A. Paul (Eds.), Causation and Counterfactuals. MIT Press.

note.zh-TW: 小蘇與小比兩位丟石頭者出自 Hall (2004) §3.3。Hall 的版本是小蘇的石頭先到，屬於晚期阻斷（late preemption）。本案取兩顆石頭同時到達的對稱版本。
note.en: The two rock-throwers come from Hall (2004, §3.3), but his version has Suzy's rock arrive first (late preemption); this case takes the symmetric version in which the rocks arrive together.

sources.citation: Chockler, H., & Halpern, J. Y. (2004). Responsibility and blame: A structural-model approach. Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, 22, 93–115.
Lewis, D. (1973). Causation. The Journal of Philosophy, 70(17), 556–567.

note.zh-TW: Lewis 在註 12 說，他不討論對稱的過度決定（symmetric overdetermination），因為他對這類案例沒有確定的直覺。
note.en: In footnote 12 Lewis says he will not discuss symmetric overdetermination, because he lacks firm naive opinions about such cases.

verdicts.note: Billy's rock would have broken the window anyway.
